app.title: Download from Yandex Disk
scope.pickSub: Tick what you need in a list — even from different folders
setup.skipDone: Don’t download again files that were downloaded last time
types.allSub: Everything, as it is on the Disk
types.askSub: First we find all files and show which types there are: photos, videos, documents… Then you tick what to download
dest.localSub: As files in “Downloads”, with the same folders as on the Disk
dest.zip: As a ZIP archive to this computer
dest.zipSub: Files go straight into an archive and are compressed
dest.remoteSub: Straight to the cloud, nothing is saved on the computer
dest.connect: Connect a cloud or server (WebDAV, S3)…
zip.partLabel: Split a large archive into parts of
zip.packAll: Compress photos and videos too (slower, saves almost no space)
zip.note: Documents and text shrink a lot. Photos and videos are already compressed, so they go into the archive as they are: an archive of photos weighs about as much as the photos themselves.
settings.title: Settings
settings.concurrency: How many files to download at once
settings.preview: If the original photo can’t be downloaded, save a large preview
settings.eraseHistory: Keep the browser’s download list clean (files stay on disk)
settings.quietUi: Don’t show the browser’s download pop-up while downloading
setup.warn: turn off “Ask where to save each file before downloading” in the browser settings, otherwise it will ask about every file.
setup.keepTab: You can minimize the Disk tab, but don’t close it. If you do, open the Disk again and continue from the same place.
how.remote: Files are moved one by one to “{name}” with the same folders as on the Disk. Traffic goes through the computer, but no disk space is used.
how.zip: Files are downloaded and put straight into a ZIP archive inside the browser; folders are kept. The archive appears in “Downloads” when everything is done; if it is bigger than {part}, it is saved in parts of {part}, and each part opens on its own. While a part is being built, it takes temporary space on the computer’s disk.
how.local: Files are saved one by one to “Downloads” with the same folders as on the Disk.
picker.hint: Tick files and folders. Click a folder’s name to open it. You can pick from different folders.
types.title: Which files to download?
types.found: Found {files} ({size}) — {types}. Tick a whole group, or open it and pick separate types.
zip.pending: The archive will be saved to “Downloads” when a part is full or all files are downloaded.
zip.empty: No archive was created: there were no files to put in it.
unlim.failed: Unlimited: couldn’t get the list of photos
filter.scanning: First we find all files to show their types: found {files}, {types}. Downloading starts when you choose the types.
filter.ready: All files found — choose which types to download.
chip.zipped: In the archive, waiting to be saved: {n}
notice.rateLimit: Yandex asked to slow down — we’ll continue in {sec} s.
notice.confirm: The browser considers some files dangerous: open the browser’s download list and confirm saving them.
stage.zipConfirm: confirm it in the browser downloads
action.retryPreviews: Try the originals again instead of previews
confirm.title: Start a new download? The current one will be closed.
confirm.kept: Files already downloaded stay on the computer, and the new download can skip them.

confirm.zipLost.one: {n} file is in an archive part that hasn’t been saved yet — it will be lost. To keep it, press “Continue” first and wait until the end.
confirm.zipLost.other: {n} files are in an archive part that hasn’t been saved yet — they will be lost. To keep them, press “Continue” first and wait until the end.

err.extReloaded: The extension was updated. Reload the page (F5) — the download will continue from the same place.
err.extReloadedShort: The extension was updated — reload the page (F5).
err.noSession: Couldn’t read the Yandex session data. Reload the page (F5).
err.nothingPicked: Nothing selected: tick files or folders.
err.locked: This download is already running in another Yandex Disk tab.
err.dead: The extension is not responding. Reload the page (F5) — the download will continue from the same place.
err.zipNoSpace: Not enough space on the computer’s disk to save the archive. Free up space and press “Continue”.
err.zipRetry: Couldn’t save the archive ({error}). Press “Continue” to try again.
err.zipBroken: An archive part failed to save again ({error}). Its files will be downloaded again — press “Continue”. If the error repeats, free up space on the computer’s disk.
err.zipSpace: {message}. Most likely the browser is out of temporary space on the computer’s disk: free up space or choose smaller archive parts, then press “Continue”.
err.filter: All files found. Choose which types to download.
err.noSpace: The computer’s disk is full. Free up space and continue.
err.destFix: {message}. Fix the cloud settings and press “Continue”.
err.destFree: {message}. Free up space in the cloud and press “Continue”.
err.saveAs: The browser asks where to save every file. Turn off “Ask where to save each file before downloading” in the browser settings, then press “Continue”.
err.destAuth: The cloud or server doesn’t accept files — check the settings
err.destFull: The cloud or server is out of space
err.destTooLarge: The server doesn’t accept such a large file
err.destFailed: Couldn’t send the file to the cloud
err.zipAdd: Couldn’t add the file to the archive
err.pathTooLong: The file path is too long
err.canceled: The download was canceled in the browser
err.blocked: The browser or antivirus blocked the file ({code})
err.writeFailed: Couldn’t write the file to the computer ({code})
err.serverInterrupted: The Yandex server interrupted the download ({code})
err.downloadGone: The download disappeared from the browser’s list

err.noResponse: The Yandex server doesn’t give the file
err.zipStart: Couldn’t start downloading into the archive: {error}

err.badUrl: Yandex returned an unexpected file address

note.gone: The file is no longer on the Disk
note.dangerous: The browser considers this file type dangerous and waits for confirmation in the download list
note.sizeDiffers: The size differs from the one on the Disk ({got} instead of {expected} bytes)

note.preview: The original didn’t download ({cause}); saved preview {name}

report.zipped: in the archive, but this archive part isn’t saved yet
report.zippedPreview: preview in the archive, but this archive part isn’t saved yet

opt.title: Where to transfer files
opt.pageTitle: Where to transfer files — Download all from Yandex Disk
opt.subtitle: Download all from Yandex Disk
opt.intro: If the computer is short on space, files can go straight to a cloud or your own server. They pass through the browser but are not saved on the computer’s disk. The folder structure is the same as on Yandex Disk.
opt.localSub: Files are saved to the “Downloads” folder.
opt.webdavSub: Nextcloud, ownCloud, your own server, a NAS (Synology, QNAP), Hetzner Storage Box, Koofr, pCloud and others.
opt.s3Sub: Selectel, Yandex Object Storage, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, your own MinIO and others.
opt.davUrlHelp: The folder where the Disk will be transferred. If it doesn’t exist, it will be created.
opt.passwordHelp: Better create a separate app password in the cloud settings.
opt.secretHelp: Better issue a key with access to this bucket only.
opt.pathStyle: Address like {a} (path-style). Untick if the storage requires {b}.
opt.privacy: The login, password and keys are stored only in this browser and are sent only to the server you entered. The browser will ask you to let the extension access that server.
opt.errDavUrl: Enter the folder address starting with https://
opt.errS3Url: Enter the storage address starting with https://
opt.errKeys: Enter the Access Key ID and Secret Access Key
opt.errNoPermission: Without access to the server the transfer won’t work. Press the button again and allow access.
opt.checking: Checking: writing and deleting a test file…
opt.savedLocal: Saved: files will be saved to this computer.
opt.saved: Saved: {name}. Go back to the Yandex Disk tab and choose it in “Where to save”.
